text:
alexa: Kando Health CISO reached out — they need SOC2 + ISO artifacts and a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. Procurement is asking for dates. POC kickoff is next Tue, can we meet that?

matt_reid: I can provide staging creds and the network diagram. Need to confirm which SOC2 artifacts are acceptable to share (scope / golden config vs internal docs).

sam_ops: @matt_reid we'll need to spin up an ephemeral staging tenant. ETA 24h once we get the OK. Also: dedicated capacity will bump price — do we have a quick number to share for their procurement?

jess_prod: For artifacts: standard shareable pack = SOC2 summary, control matrix excerpt, infrastructure diagram, pen-test attestation letter (signed). We do NOT share internal scan raw findings.

erin_legal: If procurement needs a signed pen-test letter, we must confirm signatory and the exact language. I can draft a minimal letter; need a contact name on their side for signature chain.

alexa: They asked for a 'pen-test attestation' doc that says Redwood commissions a 3rd-party pen test annually and we share redacted attestation for POC. Is that standard? @erin_legal

erin_legal: That's standard. I'll prepare a one-page attestation and include placeholders for scope (prod vs staging). Will circulate for @jess_prod review.

matt_reid: Quick note on staging creds: we'll provide a scoped API key + ephemeral admin console access (SAML invite). Example permissions I plan to give: read/write to demo tenant, no access to other customers.

sam_ops: Pricing: for 2-week POC with burst to dedicated-ish perf, rough uplift is +25% on hosted per-token until we scale to reserved dedicated. I can put together a breakout.

alexa: Procurement also asked for ISO cert copy or at least the cert number. We only have ISO in scope for some private deployments — can we share the cert if available, or provide a letter? @jess_prod
jess_prod: We have ISO attestation for our private offering; for hosted we can provide a scoped statement of compliance. I'll add wording.

secbot: Automated note: SOC2 report redaction checklist v2.1 available at https://intra/docs/compliance/redaction-checklist — please follow before uploading. :white_check_mark:

alexa: Action items: @erin_legal draft attestation, @matt_reid staging creds + diagram by EOD, @sam_ops pricing breakout by tomorrow noon, @jess_prod confirm shareable artifact list and wording. I'll update Kando POC ticket and loop in their procurement contact once we have docs. :thumbsup:

erin_legal: On it. Requesting Kando contact: who on their side is the procurement lead?

alexa: it's rachel.k@kandohealth.com — I'll intro via email after we have the draft.

matt_reid: noted, working on creds. I'll paste the network diagram link here when ready.

sam_ops: pricing doc draft: will include hosted baseline + 2-week POC uplift + dedicated estimate and note about data residency cost.

jess_prod: I'll prepare the one-page artifact index they can attach to RFP.

alexa: Thanks team — if we can hit these by EOD tomorrow we should be able to satisfy procurement and keep the POC start.

(reacts: :rocket: from alexa, :eyes: from matt_reid)
